reasons: The full text is pinned and hash-verified in a community mirror.

The paper itself is not served from an official paper-display page, so the level is B rather than A.

page_evidence.observation: The summary sheet states two simulation scales, five objectives, a three-step control plan, and stress tests.
A labeled aerial image and origin-destination matrix establish geometry and demand.
Macro and micro simulations are compared before parameter sensitivity is introduced.
Signal timing, five objective values, and a traffic snapshot share one result page.
Alternative layouts and a repeated-run sensitivity table test transfer and stability.
An emergency breakdown scenario is visualized as a failure-mode probe.

abstract_structure.observation: Summarize macro and micro simulations, multi-objective scoring, a three-step control policy, and robustness cases on the summary sheet.

model_chain.observation: Encode a six-arm roundabout and origin-destination flow matrix.
Use a macro flow model and cellular-automata-like vehicle simulation.
Optimize signal, sign, and flow-adaptation decisions over five criteria.
Transfer the policy to different traffic circles and demand levels.

validation_chain.observation: Compare two simulation models on average travel time.
Run 50 repetitions and test a different roundabout layout.
Simulate a blocked vehicle and observe whether traffic continues.

figures.chart_type: annotated aerial image plus OD table
figures.lesson: Bind every arm label to the demand matrix before modeling.

figures.chart_type: timing strip plus KPI table plus snapshot
figures.lesson: Combine decision, metrics, and resulting state on one page.
Show both structural transfer and stochastic variation.
Visualize an adverse event rather than describing robustness only in prose.

code_links.note: No independently packaged source tree was paired with this exact PDF; embedded appendix fragments are not treated as reproducible code.

transferable_rules.rule: Use an independently structured second model as a cross-check when direct ground truth is unavailable.
Present optimized controls, objective values, and system state together.
Design at least one failure-mode probe tied to the operational claim.

risks.risk: The summary includes decorative road signs that consume scarce first-page area.
Some result figures and tables use small labels and a light blue Office style.
Emergency testing is qualitative and reports limited quantitative degradation.

provenance.review_method: full-page render overview plus 4-7 high-resolution evidence-page visual checks and extracted-text review
